metadata.source: NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA) & SPHEREx Project Science Office
metadata.mission: SPHEREx (Spectro-Photometer for the History of the Universe, Epoch of Reionization and Ices Explorer)
metadata.missionStatus: Operational in Orbit (Launched March 2025; Quick Release 3 active since September 2026)
metadata.dataStatus: Operational In-Flight Mission Products & IRSA TAP/SIA Schema (Quick Release 3)
metadata.description: Verified SPHEREx in-flight spectral channels, detector arrays, Quick Release 3 Level 2 products, and IRSA TAP Obscore schemas.

telescopeSpecifications.detectors: Six 2048×2048 Teledyne Hawaii-2RG (H2RG) arrays with Linear Variable Filters (LVFs)
telescopeSpecifications.orbit: Sun-synchronous low Earth polar terminator orbit (altitude ~650 km)
telescopeSpecifications.surveyCoverage: All-sky 4π steradians surveyed every 6 months (4 complete all-sky maps over 2-year primary mission)

primaryScienceTracers.scientificRole: Measures absorption depth in dense molecular cloud cores to trace water delivery to forming planetary systems.
Maps volatile carbon budget and ice chemistry across protostellar envelopes.
Traces cold interstellar snow lines where temperatures drop below 20 Kelvin.
Measures diffuse light fluctuations from the first stars and proto-galaxies during the Epoch of Reionization.
Determines 3D positions of 450+ million galaxies to measure primordial non-Gaussianity from cosmic inflation.
